Author: Rakesh Thapliyal
Bench: Rakesh Thapliyal
 Office Notes,
 reports, orders
Sl. or proceedings or
 Date Court'S Or Judges'S Order
S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  13.06.2024 WPCRL No. 627 of 2024  Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Ms. Krishi Shukla Bhandari, learned counsel for the petitioners and Mr. V.K. Jemini, learned Deputy Advocate General for the State.

2. By the instant writ petition, the petitioners are challenging the impugned FIR dated 29.01.2024,
bearing FIR No. 0024 of 2024, whereby the petitioners have been implicated for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 120B, 504, 506 and 471 of IPC.
3.
By the impugned FIR, in total five persons have been implicated.

It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioners that the accused No. 1 Manjeet Singh is the real brother of the respondent/complainant and whatever dispute exists, that is in between the respondent and his real brother Manjeet Singh and the petitioners have no concern with the transactions in between the respondent and Manjeet Singh.
4.

It is also submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioners that the petitioners are the members of the panchayat and in the panchayat, a compromise was held on 16.01.2022 in between the complainant/ respondent and his real brother Manjeet Singh and the petitioners only mediate in between both of them.

5. It is further submitted that the petitioners have been falsely implicated and they have no nexus in transactions in between the respondent and Manjeet Singh, who has already been arrested and now in jail.
6.
Mr. V.K. Jemini, learned Deputy Advocate General accepts notice for respondent Nos. 1 & 2.

He submits that the investigation is still going on and has not disputed this fact that Manjeet Singh has already been arrested and is in jail and so far as the role of the present petitioners are concerned,
that can only be ascertained only after filing counter affidavits.
He prays for and is granted four weeks' time to file the counter affidavit.

7. Issue notice to respondent No. 3.
WPCRL/627/2024 on 13 June, 2024

8. Learned counsel for the petitioners within a week, by registered post acknowledgement due,
returnable within three weeks.

In the meantime, the investigation pursuant to the FIR, bearing FIR No. 0024 of 2024 dated 29.01.2024, P.S. Transit Camp, District Udham Singh Nagar, may go on; however, the petitioners shall not be arrested provided they cooperate with the investigation.

(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.) 13.06.2024 Mahinder/
WPCRL/627/2024 on 13 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/158663827/
